name: draw_play
description: Draw a new play from the coach's spoken call, using the team's own formations and concepts. Returns status 'drawn' with a draw_id (pass it to show_draw), 'unresolved' with notes (questions for the coach), 'rate_limited' with retry_after_seconds, 'timeout', or 'unavailable'.

call.description: The play call as the coach said it, e.g. 'spread right hash, field mills, boundary smash'. Keep the coach's words; do not add routes or players they did not say.
